summary: South Carolina Forestry Commission lookout tower in Spartanburg County, photographed near I-26 in 2009; no build date or current status found.

events.note: Photo of the tower taken 17 February 2009; caption calls it the Hobbyville Lookout Tower

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts lists the site under the South Carolina Forestry Commission in Spartanburg County
Forest Lookouts gives the county as Spartanburg County
Forest Lookouts entry offers only a satellite-view link beyond the county and agency
Photo caption calls it the Hobbyville Lookout Tower, located just off I-26 southeast of Woodruff
evidence.quote: Distant view of the Hobbyville Lookout Tower. Located just off of I-26 southeast of Woodruff, SC

evidence.supports: South Carolina phased out its lookout towers in the early 1990s
evidence.quote: South Carolina phased out its towers in the early 1990s.

evidence.supports: Article gives 1993 as the year of a lookout job loss, in the same sentence as the statewide closures

evidence.quote: more than 100 towers around the state closed

sources.title: Looking out for last fire towers

notes_for_editor: Only two lookout-specific sources (a Forest Lookouts index entry with no detail, and one Flickr caption). No build date, height, staffing or current status found. Name is spelled Hobbysville in the record and on Forest Lookouts, Hobbyville in the 2009 Flickr captions and local usage; check the spelling before publishing. Photo license not checked, so no photos added. The Post and Courier article is undated; its 1993 link to the statewide closures comes from one sentence about a lookout job loss, so the story says the article links them rather than dating each closure.
